meta.title: Mi Mesa — My table, my feast
meta.description: A modern reading of Mesopotamian village cuisine. At Mi Mesa, story, heritage, and the table become one.

hero.subtitle: A heritage carried from the dusty roads of Mesopotamia, from quiet evenings around the fire, to your senses.

manifesto.title: The memory of a feast,
manifesto.body: Mi Mesa carries the smell of bread baked in old village courtyards, the warmth of the copper pot in a grandmother's hand, and the quiet gratitude at a grandfather's table — all into the present. Every plate tells a story; every story carries a heritage.
manifesto.body2: We see dining not as performance, but as invitation, as sharing, as meeting. When we say "my table, my feast", we welcome you not as a guest but as part of a shared memory.

heritage.title: The memory of the soil,
heritage.body: Our grains come from small producers, our greens follow the season's true calendar, our meats from traditional growers in the mountain villages. Every ingredient has a name, an address, a story.

captions.two: Copper pot / from one generation to the next

menu.title: Open the evening,
menu.body: Browse our digital menu — it changes with the season, the harvest, and the chef's inspiration on the night.

chef.title: The quiet
chef.name: Chef Aram Demir
chef.quote: "I do not cook recipes; I cook memory. Every plate is the rememberance of a village, a season, an evening."
chef.body: Aram Demir grew up in the narrow alleys of Mardin, matured in the most exacting kitchens of Europe, and finally returned to our own table. Mi Mesa is a letter he writes to his grandmother's pots.

meta.title: Menu — Mi Mesa
meta.description: Mi Mesa menu: salads, fire-cooked meats, Anatolian kitchen, sweets and sips. Plates with a story, renewed by the season.

index.title: Let us open,
index.subtitle: A menu that changes with the season, the harvest, and the chef's nightly inspiration. Each title is a door; behind it, a story and a plate.
index.footnote: Prices are in Turkish Liras. Our menu shifts with the season, the day's harvest, and the chef's mood. Please share any allergies or dietary preferences with our team.
